title: Description size bound for the verifier
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, with $n>0$, and let $m$ be its number of associated quadratic variables. The description size of its four-query PCPP system is at most $6\cdot 2^{3(m+1)^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
